parameters.jsCode: 'use strict';const x=$input.first()?.json||{};const t=v=>String(v??'').normalize('NFKC').trim();const requestId=t(x.requestId);const principalKey=t(x.principalKey);const actor=t(x.telegramActorId);if(!/^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{8,160}$/.test(requestId))throw new Error('privacy_delivery_request_id_invalid');if(!/^tgactor_[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(principalKey))throw new Error('privacy_delivery_principal_invalid');if(!/^\d+$/.test(actor))throw new Error('privacy_delivery_actor_invalid');return [{json:{requestId,principalKey,telegramActorId:actor}}];
